title: Jibhi, Tirthan & Kasol
reportingPoint: Departure is in the evening from Delhi or Chandigarh. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip; report at the pickup point 30 minutes early.
overview:
Two valleys in one long weekend: this **3 Nights / 4 Days** group trip leaves Delhi or Chandigarh every Friday evening in an AC push-back vehicle for an overnight journey to Jibhi.

Day 1 covers Jibhi Waterfall and Mini Thailand, with a bonfire in the evening. Day 2 drives to Jalori Pass (weather permitting) and treks 4 km through tall forest to Serolsar Lake. Day 3 is the trek to Choiee Waterfall in Tirthan Valley before a taxi to Kasol. Day 4 is for Kasol's cafes and market, the riverside trail to Chalal and Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara before the overnight journey home. Two nights in Jibhi, one in Kasol, 6 meals, all permits and a tour curator are included. Prices start at ₹8,500 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).
highlights: Serolsar Lake trek, 4 km through tall forest from Jalori
Choiee Waterfall trek in Tirthan Valley
Kasol cafes, market and the 3 km riverside trail to Chalal
Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara and its hot springs

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi / Chandigarh
itinerary.content:
Assemble at the pickup point in Delhi or Chandigarh, meet your team captain and the group.
Depart in the evening for the overnight journey to Jibhi in an AC push-back vehicle.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: Reach Jibhi | Jibhi Waterfall | Mini Thailand
itinerary.content:
Reach Jibhi in the morning, check in and relax after the long journey.
By noon, head to Jibhi Waterfall and Mini Thailand for valley views and a riverside walk.
Evening bonfire with light music.
Dinner and overnight stay in Jibhi.

itinerary.title: Jalori Pass | Serolsar Lake trek
itinerary.content:
Wake up early for the sunrise, then breakfast.
Drive to Jalori Pass (weather permitting) and trek 4 km to Serolsar Lake along a narrow track lined with tall trees.
Back to the stay for a bonfire with light music, dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Choiee Waterfall, Tirthan Valley | Transfer to Kasol
itinerary.content:
Breakfast and check out.
Trek to Choiee Waterfall in Tirthan Valley and explore the nearby cafes.
Depart for Kasol by taxi (included), check in, then dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Kasol | Chalal | Manikaran Sahib | Departure
itinerary.content:
Wake up early, have breakfast and check out.
Explore the Kasol market and cafes, and walk to Chalal village (a 3 km riverside trail, both ways).
Visit Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara, famous for its hot water spring.
Depart for Delhi or Chandigarh, reaching the next morning.

includes: Stay: 2 nights in Jibhi and 1 night in Kasol
Jalori Pass and Serolsar Lake trek
AC tempo traveller, Innova or AC deluxe bus, as per group size
excludes: Food and beverages not included in the package
Non-AC vehicles for local sightseeing; 4x4 vehicle in snow
Costs from natural calamities or circumstances beyond our control
Any other expense not listed under the inclusions

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: The trip leaves Delhi or Chandigarh every Friday evening for an overnight journey to Jibhi in an AC push-back vehicle. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.

faqs.q: How much does the Jibhi, Tirthan & Kasol trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹8,500 per person on quad sharing, ₹9,000 on triple sharing and ₹9,500 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

2 nights in Jibhi and 1 night in Kasol, 6 meals (3 breakfasts and 3 dinners), the Jalori Pass and Serolsar Lake trek, Kasol and Manikaran sightseeing, AC transport as per group size, a taxi from Tirthan to Kasol, a bonfire with light music, all permits and a tour curator.
Two short treks: 4 km from Jalori Pass to Serolsar Lake on Day 2 (weather permitting), and a trek to Choiee Waterfall in Tirthan Valley on Day 3. Chalal in Kasol is a 3 km riverside walk, both ways.
The first two nights are in Jibhi and the third night is in Kasol. Extra mattresses are provided for triple and quad sharing.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat with a ₹3,000 advance per person (UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking) and pay the rest 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. There are no refunds for inclusions you don't use, and bookings can't be transferred.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack a down or main jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, outdoor shoes, a daypack and personal medication. The full list is under Things To Pack.
